adaptation: Codex-authored English CLI scene, closed predicates, nine selected variants. Historical NPC/table identity is provenance, not a new canon claim.
accepted_differences: New framing, English responses, herbs prerequisite, four endings and 12-turn budget.
Only stress, trust, respect, mood, session flags/events and cooldown are modeled. No fear, debt, trait/norm scoring, arbitrary DSL, event TTL or engine binding.
Action-specific gates replace the original tags: herbs=OBSESSION_TOPIC, ask=STAKES_LOW, apologize=PLAYER_IS_WRONG + PLAYER_APOLOGIZED only for an unresolved lie.
Stress 80 comes from the selected catalog conditions; profile OutburstThreshold 88 is not used. Cooldown 5 comes from the profile.
Existing outbursts permit only wait or leave. Five subsequent accepted waits restore WARY; the entry turn and invalid/diagnostic input do not tick cooldown.
Herbs can be sorted once. Each new lie opens one apology; apology closes that obligation while historical lie flags remain. Memory is session-local and reset by restart.
